purpose: smaller sample of latency-benchmark-v1 for the live sessions of U1 to U7; latency and outcome counts; not an accuracy set
selection: From data/evaluation/latency-benchmark-v1/ids.json: within each language (en, zh) and length_tercile (1 to 3), the rows ordered by the hexadecimal SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string "latency-benchmark-v1:<record_id>", ascending (the order the source set was selected in), and the first 5 taken. Rows are copied unchanged and listed by language, tercile, then that order. Every ID is also in latency-benchmark-v1.
